provenance: Existing successful public UW-area Overpass response; no new network request for bundle expansion. Original feature coordinates and properties preserved byte-for-byte under JSON serialization.
coverageNote: metadata.coverageBounds is the requested coverage rectangle; GeoJSON bbox encloses all complete OSM ways, including those extending outside requested coverage.
limitations: Static roads, buildings, parks and water geometry; no street labels or routing. Native rendering validation is separate. This does not establish that online Save my area works.
